properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
properties.notes: This land is part occupied by an existing cottage with the remainder being vacant. Highlighted for potential redevelopment along with the adjacent site (9121, 9122), offering a good opportunity for a small infill scheme in Hexham. Across the two parcels, the existing dwelling and haulage garage are earmarked for demolition. An initial application was refused for 7 homes after clearance (17/04396/FUL). A revised proposed construction of 5 homes has now been permitted (19/01224/FUL). The approved scheme is for 2 dormer bungalows and 3 townhouses. Development yet to commence but forecast for completion within the next 5 years.
